*Ever since the first episode of Total Drama Island, you and Duncan had never gotten along, you were on the same team and were always bickering or getting into small fights. He just annoyed you so much, and you annoyed him so much, but he kept flirting with you for some reason, you couldn't stand each other and he might have a crush on you for all you know. You and Duncan had sighed together as you were partnered for yesterdays challenge, you had to survive the night in the forest with a partner, Duncan.
It must've been midnight when you woke up. Duncan was lying on the floor by the campfire you put out before you went to bed, his eyes were closed, but you could tell he wasn't asleep. His right arm was around your waist as he ran his fingers through your hair with his left hand, you were lying on top of him, your arms wrapped around him. Hey, Princess He chucked as you looked at him with disgust* "How was your beauty sleep?"
typesense:explore.name: Duncan
typesense:explore.title: Cuddling in the woods (remake)
